Your account has been locked

Your account has been locked following a routine check designed to keep your money and personal information safe. All active transfers have been cancelled and any payments already made will be refunded to your original payment method.

Learn more about locked accounts.

At this time, you won’t be able to make new online transfers. You can still sign in to your account to view past activity and, if you believe this decision was made in error, request a review.

  • A selfie holding your government-issued ID (passport, driver’s license, or national ID)
  • Clear photos of your ID (front and back)
  • A recent bank statement showing your name and recent transactions
  • A utility bill matching your registered address
  • Any additional proof of your recent transfer(s)

Accounts added before 5 p.m. Monday – Friday
The deposits should show up in your account within a few hours.

Accounts added after 5 p.m. Monday – Thursday
The deposits should show up in your account the next morning.

And if you added the account during these times:

• After 5 p.m. on a Friday
• On a banking holiday
• Anytime during the weekend

The deposits will show up in your account on the next business day.
